units.source_text: 在父母面前，我不得不装出正在努力寻找这种好工作的样子。

en.t: In front of my parents, I had to pretend that I was making every effort to find such a good position.

units.source_text: 我给先生写了一封信，详细地说明了家中的情况，

en.t: I wrote Sensei a letter, explaining in detail the circumstances at home,

units.source_text: 并拜托他，如果有什么适合我的工作，请帮忙介绍一下，不管做什么都可以。

en.t: and asked him to introduce me to any work suited to me, if there was any, no matter what kind it was.

units.source_text: 我虽然觉得先生是不会理睬我这一请托的，

en.t: Although I felt that Sensei would not take this request of mine seriously,

units.source_text: 而且就算他愿意帮助我，以他那样狭窄的交际圈，终归是无济于事的。

en.t: and that even if he wanted to help me, with his narrow circle of acquaintances it would be useless in the end.

units.source_text: 但我还是写了这封信，我总觉得先生一定会回信的。

en.t: Still, I wrote the letter, because I somehow felt sure Sensei would reply.

units.source_text: 我封好信，去寄信之前对母亲说：

en.t: After sealing the letter, before I went to mail it, I said to Mother:

units.source_text: “给先生的信写好了，是按你说的意思写的，你看看吧。”

en.t: "I have written the letter to Sensei. I wrote it the way you suggested. Please take a look."

units.source_text: 正如我预料的，母亲没有看。

en.t: Just as I had expected, Mother did not read it.

units.source_text: “是吗？那就赶快发出去吧。

en.t: "Is that so? Then hurry up and send it.

units.source_text: 这种事就算别人不督促，自己也该早点着手的。”

en.t: This is the sort of thing you ought to start on early yourself, even if no one else urges you."

units.source_text: 母亲似乎还把我当孩子看，我也觉得自己像个孩子。

en.t: Mother seemed still to regard me as a child, and I too felt like a child.

units.source_text: “可是光寄信，是办不成事的。

en.t: "But sending a letter alone will not get anything done.

units.source_text: 不管怎样，九月份我得去东京一趟。”

en.t: In any case, I have to go to Tokyo in September."

units.source_text: “也许你说得对吧。

en.t: "Perhaps you are right.

units.source_text: 不过也说不定会碰上什么好工作呢，最好是早些拜托他。”

en.t: But you never know, some good opening might turn up, so it is best to ask him early."

units.source_text: “是啊。反正先生一定会回信的，

en.t: "Yes. In any case, Sensei is sure to answer,

units.source_text: 到时候再说吧。”

en.t: so let us talk about it then."

units.source_text: 在这方面，我很相信一向守信用的先生。

en.t: In this respect, I trusted Sensei, who had always kept his promises.

units.source_text: 我天天盼着先生的回信，但是，我的期待终究落空了。

en.t: Day after day I looked forward to Sensei's reply, but in the end my expectation came to nothing.

units.source_text: 过了一个星期，依然没有先生一点儿音讯。

en.t: A week passed, and still there was not a word from Sensei.

units.source_text: “大概是到什么地方避暑去了吧。”

en.t: "He has probably gone somewhere to escape the summer heat."
